note: TD3 (CTBR, v2) hyper-parameter study. Seed 0, 25 M environment steps per setting (1024 envs), evaluated with the v2 protocol (512 episodes, eval seed 1000; sweep points 30 % and 50 % of weight). 'v1hp' = default setting (25 M snapshot of the 100 M default run).

v1hp.label: default TD3 (Fujimoto et al.): expl. noise 0.2, target noise 0.2 / clip 0.5, 1-step, lr 3e-4

noise01_n10.label: noise01 + 10-step returns
noise01_n10.diverged: critic diverged (Q loss > 1e4 from 3.7 M steps, > 1e13 by 11 M); every episode crashes

noise01_n5_lr1e4.label: noise01_n5 + lr 1e-4
noise01_n5_lr1e4.diverged: returns collapsed at ~4 M steps, Q loss > 1e4 from 5.3 M; stopped at 13.8 M

choice_reason: Stable n-step setting (n=3: no divergence in 4 runs; n=5 and n=10 diverged in 2 of 4 runs) with the best gust rejection and recovery among the stable configs (peak 12.5 cm, 93 % of episodes recover vs 73 %), steady error 4.1 cm, success 98.8 %. n=5 configs had slightly lower steady error (3.7 cm) but a 100 M-step, 3-seed run risks critic divergence.
